BuildingBlockModule.name: Modules.Payment.Domain

ModuleMeta.Name: Payment Domain
ModuleMeta.Description: Payment processing DDD domain: Payments with capture/void/refund, PaymentMethods with gateway tokenization, Gateway definitions (e.g., Stripe), PaymentCaptureEvents for audit, and RefundReasons for categorization.

Principle.name: Payment State Machine
Principle.Description: Payments follow strict state transitions: Created→Authorized→Captured. Void before capture, Refund after capture.
Principle.Rationale: Mirrors payment gateway lifecycle; prevents invalid operations.

Principle.name: Tokenized Storage
Principle.Description: PaymentMethods store only gateway tokens — never raw card data.
Principle.Rationale: PCI compliance: domain and database never touch sensitive card details.

Feature.name: Payment Aggregate
Feature.Description: Payment with capture, void, refund operations and state tracking.

Feature.name: Payment Methods
Feature.Description: Tokenized payment methods linked to gateway.

Abstraction.name: Payment
Abstraction.Description: Payment aggregate with state machine (capture, void, refund).

Abstraction.name: PaymentMethod
Abstraction.Description: Tokenized payment method stored for reuse.

AntiPattern.name: Card Data in Domain
AntiPattern.Avoid: Storing raw credit card numbers in domain models.
AntiPattern.BetterApproach: Only store gateway tokens; raw card data never enters domain layer.
